  SUM(case when is_paid_eligible then net_cents else 0 end) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
FROM "data"."main"."member_month_stats" member_month_stats_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'

coverage_notes.source: 青禾新 CRM 系统导出(会员/订单/会员卡/门店四表);小林工作账回访与勿扰名单仅用于对照核验,不导入查询库;线上商城独立订单流与退卡流水未包含在本次导出。

monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT case when is_paid_eligible and valid_order_cnt >= 2 then member_id end) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
FROM "data"."main"."member_month_stats" member_month_stats_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'

monthly_paid_repeat_rate.sql:
SELECT
  case when monthly_paid_buyer_count = 0 then null else monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count / monthly_paid_buyer_count end AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT case when is_paid_eligible and valid_order_cnt >= 2 then member_id end) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT case when is_paid_eligible and valid_order_cnt >= 1 then member_id end) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."member_month_stats" member_month_stats_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_8

monthly_paid_avg_order_value.sql:
SELECT
  case when monthly_paid_order_count = 0 then null else monthly_paid_sales_cents / monthly_paid_order_count end AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(case when is_paid_eligible then net_cents else 0 end) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , SUM(case when is_paid_eligible then valid_order_cnt else 0 end) AS monthly_paid_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."member_month_stats" member_month_stats_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_8
